pages.purpose: See how this single operation changes the known input.
pages.originatingScene: Stable scene/object identity already established for this operation
pages.whyNow: The particular missing fact or operation needed to advance the main task
pages.knownInput: Exact formula, object and previous page that supply the source
pages.newIncrement: One change, not a list of new concepts
pages.dominantResult: One prominent expression or visibly established output
conditions: State example/general and all necessary assumptions next to the result

clicks.change: derive or explain the matched result

numericalInvariants: Actual equality or preserved quantity to test

pages.continuation: Which following step uses this result

return.scene: Same originating scene when this is a branch
return.retainedResult: Only the conclusion needed to proceed, with its conditions
return.consumer: Actual following operation that uses it
